text: 【国联民生证券向香港子公司增资不超20亿元获监管批文】国联民生证券最新公告，公司近日收到中国证监会《关于国联民生证券股份有限公司向香港子公司增资有关意见的复函》，对公司以自有资金向全资子公司国联证券（香港）有限公司增资不超过20亿元人民币无异议，公司将根据相关要求完成备案手续，并针对国联香港业务需求及市场情况分批进行。
text_en: [Guolian Minsheng Securities receives regulatory approval to increase capital in its Hong Kong subsidiary by no more than 2 billion yuan] Guolian Minsheng Securities announced in its latest filing that the company recently received a reply letter from the China Securities Regulatory Commission on its capital increase in its Hong Kong subsidiary, stating no objection to the company using its own funds to increase capital in its wholly owned subsidiary Guolian Securities (Hong Kong) Limited by no more than 2 billion yuan. The company will complete the filing procedures in accordance with relevant requirements and proceed in batches according to the business needs and market conditions of Guolian Hong Kong.
